verses.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?
verses.pt: Então Samuel tomou um vaso de azeite, e o derramou sobre a cabeça de Saul, e o beijou, e disse: Porventura não te ungiu o Senhor para ser príncipe sobre a sua herança?
verses.en_web: Then Samuel took the vial of oil, and poured it on his head, and kissed him, and said, “Hasn’t Yahweh anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel took the bottle of oil, and put the oil on his head and gave him a kiss and said, Is not the Lord with the holy oil making you ruler over Israel, his people? and you will have authority over the people of the Lord, and you will make them safe from the hands of their attackers round about them, and this will be the sign for you:

verses.en: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
verses.pt: Quando te apartares hoje de mim, encontrarás dois homens junto ao sepulcro de Raquel, no termo de Benjamim, em Zelza, os quais te dirão: Acharam-se as jumentas que foste buscar, e eis que já o teu pai deixou de pensar nas jumentas, e anda aflito por causa de ti, dizendo: Que farei eu por meu filho?
verses.en_web: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys, and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’
verses.en_bbe: When you have gone away from me today, you will see two men by the resting-place of Rachel's body, in the land of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say to you, The asses which you went in search of have come back, and now your father, caring no longer for the asses, is troubled about you, saying, What am I to do about my son?

verses.en: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
verses.pt: Então dali passarás mais adiante, e chegarás ao carvalho de Tabor; ali te encontrarão três homens, que vão subindo a Deus, a Betel, levando um três cabritos, outro três formas de pão, e o outro um odre de vinho.
verses.en_web: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine.
verses.en_bbe: Then you are to go on from there, and when you come to the oak-tree of Tabor, you will see three men going up to God to Beth-el, one having with him three young goats and another three cakes of bread and another a skin full of wine:

verses.en: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
verses.pt: Eles te saudarão, e te darão dois pães, que receberás das mãos deles.
verses.en_web: They will greet you, and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.
verses.en_bbe: They will say, Peace be with you, and will give you two cakes of bread, which you are to take from them.

verses.en: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
verses.pt: Depois chegarás ao outeiro de Deus, onde está a guarnição dos filisteus; ao entrares ali na cidade, encontrarás um grupo de profetas descendo do alto, precedido de saltérios, tambores, flautas e harpas, e eles profetizando.
verses.en_web: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.
verses.en_bbe: After that you will come to Gibeah, the hill of God, where an armed force of the Philistines is stationed: and when you come to the town, you will see a band of prophets coming down from the high place with instruments of music before them; and they will be acting like prophets:

verses.en: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
verses.pt: E o Espírito do Senhor se apoderará de ti, e profetizarás com eles, e serás transformado em outro homem.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, and you will prophesy with them, and will be turned into another man.
verses.en_bbe: And the spirit of the Lord will come on you with power, and you will be acting like a prophet with them, and will be changed into another man.

verses.en: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
verses.pt: Quando estes sinais te vierem, faze o que achar a tua mão para fazer, pois Deus é contigo.
verses.en_web: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.
verses.en_bbe: And when these signs come to you, see that you take the chance which is offered you; for God is with you.

verses.en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
verses.pt: Tu, porém, descerás adiante de mim a Gilgal, e eis que eu descerei a ter contigo, para oferecer holocaustos e sacrifícios de ofertas pacíficas. Esperarás sete dias, até que eu vá ter contigo e te declare o que hás de fazer.
verses.en_web: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you, and show you what you are to do.”
verses.en_bbe: Then you are to go down before me to Gilgal, where I will come to you, for the offering of burned offerings and peace-offerings: go on waiting there for seven days till I come to you and make clear to you what you have to do.

verses.en: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
verses.pt: Ao virar Saul as costas para se apartar de Samuel, Deus lhe mudou o coração em outro; e todos esses sinais aconteceram naquele mesmo dia.
verses.en_web: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, that when he went away from Samuel, God gave him a changed heart: and all those signs took place that day.

verses.en: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.pt: Quando eles iam chegando ao outeiro, eis que um grupo de profetas lhes saiu ao encontro; e o Espírito de Deus se apoderou de Saul, e ele profetizou no meio deles.
verses.en_web: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to Gibeah, a band of prophets came face to face with him; and the spirit of God came on him with power and he took his place among them as a prophet.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.pt: Todos os que o tinham conhecido antes, ao verem que ele profetizava com os profetas, diziam uns aos outros: Que é que sucedeu ao filho de Quis? Está também Saul entre os profetas?
verses.en_web: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.en_bbe: Now when Saul's old friends saw him among the band of prophets, the people said to one another, What has come to Saul, the son of Kish? Is even Saul among the prophets?

verses.en: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
verses.pt: Então um homem dali respondeu, e disse: Pois quem é o pai deles? Pelo que se tornou em provérbio: Está também Saul entre os profetas?
verses.en_web: One of the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.en_bbe: And one of the people of that place said in answer, And who is their father? So it became a common saying, Is even Saul among the prophets?

verses.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.pt: Tendo ele acabado de profetizar, foi ao alto.
verses.en_web: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
verses.en_bbe: Then going away from the prophets, he came to the house.

verses.en: And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
verses.pt: Depois o tio de Saul perguntou-lhe, a ele e ao seu moço: Aonde fostes?: Respondeu ele: Procurar as jumentas; e, não as tendo encontrado, fomos ter com Samuel.
verses.en_web: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul's father's brother said to him and his servant, Where have you been? And he said, Searching for the asses: and when we saw no sign of them, we came to Samuel.

verses.en: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
verses.pt: Disse mais o tio de Saul: Declara-me, peço-te, o que vos disse Samuel.
verses.en_web: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, And what did Samuel say to you?

verses.en: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
verses.pt: Ao que respondeu Saul a seu tio: Declarou-nos, seguramente, que as jumentas tinham sido encontradas. Mas quanto ao assunto do reino, de que Samuel falara, nada lhe declarou.
verses.en_web: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul, answering him, said, He gave us word that the asses had come back. But he said nothing to him of Samuel's words about the kingdom.

verses.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;
verses.pt: Então Samuel convocou o povo ao Senhor em Mizpá;
verses.en_web: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel sent for the people to come together before the Lord at Mizpah;

verses.en: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
verses.pt: e disse aos filhos de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Eu fiz subir a Israel do Egito, e vos livrei da mão dos egípcios e da mão de todos os reinos que vos oprimiam.
verses.en_web: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the children of Israel, The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, I took Israel out of Egypt, and made you free from the hands of the Egyptians and from all the kingdoms which kept you down:

verses.en: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
verses.pt: Mas vós hoje rejeitastes a vosso Deus, àquele que vos livrou de todos os vossos males e angústias, e lhe dissestes: Põe um rei sobre nós. Agora, pois, ponde-vos perante o Senhor, segundo as vossas tribos e segundo os vossos milhares.
verses.en_web: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes, and by your thousands.”
verses.en_bbe: But today you are turned away from your God, who himself has been your saviour from all your troubles and sorrows; and you have said to him, Put a king over us. So now, take your places before the Lord by your tribes and by your thousands.

verses.en: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
verses.pt: Tendo, pois, Samuel feito chegar todas as tribos de Israel, foi tomada por sorte a tribo de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.
verses.en_bbe: So Samuel made all the tribes of Israel come near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

verses.en: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
verses.pt: E, quando fez chegar a tribo de Benjamim segundo as suas famílias, foi tomada a família de Matri, e dela foi tomado Saul, filho de Quis; e o procuraram, mas não foi encontrado.
verses.en_web: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.
verses.en_bbe: Then he made the tribe of Benjamin come near by families, and the family of the Matrites was taken: and from them, Saul, the son of Kish, was taken: but when they went in search of him he was nowhere to be seen.

verses.en: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
verses.pt: Pelo que tornaram a perguntar ao Senhor: Não veio o homem ainda para cá? E respondeu o Senhor: Eis que se escondeu por entre a bagagem:
verses.en_web: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
verses.en_bbe: So they put another question to the Lord, Is the man present here? And the answer of the Lord was, He is keeping himself from view among the goods.

verses.en: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.pt: Correram, pois, e o trouxeram dali; e estando ele no meio do povo, sobressaía em altura a todo o povo desde os ombros para cima.
verses.en_web: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
verses.en_bbe: So they went quickly and made him come out; and when he took his place among the people, he was taller by a head than any of the people.

verses.en: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
verses.pt: Então disse Samuel a todo o povo: Vedes já a quem o Senhor escolheu: Não há entre o povo nenhum semelhante a ele. Então todo o povo o aclamou, dizendo: Viva o rei;
verses.en_web: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted, and said, “Long live the king!”
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said to all the people, Do you see the man of the Lord's selection, how there is no other like him among all the people? And all the people with loud cries said, Long life to the king!

verses.en: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.pt: Também declarou Samuel ao povo a lei do reino, e a escreveu num livro, e pô-lo perante o Senhor. Então Samuel despediu todo o povo, cada um para sua casa.
verses.en_web: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel gave the people the laws of the kingdom, writing them in a book which he put in a safe place before the Lord. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

verses.en: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.pt: E foi também Saul para sua casa em Gibeá; e foram com ele homens de valor, aqueles cujo coração Deus tocara.
verses.en_web: Saul also went to his house to Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul went to Gibeah, to his house; and with him went the men of war whose hearts had been touched by God.

verses.en: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
verses.pt: Mas alguns homens ímpios disseram: Como pode este homem nos livrar? E o desprezaram, e não lhe trouxeram presentes; porém ele se fez como surdo.
verses.en_web: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no present. But he held his peace.
verses.en_bbe: But certain good-for-nothing persons said, How is this man to be our saviour? And having no respect for him, they gave him no offering.
